description: arXiv:2608.16889v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) increasingly master individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising pathway...
